mostWorthwhile.text: Storing glucose in muscle made the difference between insulin as a message and glucose as building material clear.

leastWorthwhile.text: Placing the hormones was straightforward but didn't show their effects until the following combinations.

surprise.text: The liver's release signal eases as blood glucose rises, adding a return signal to the between-meals route.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, though the hotspot placements felt like setup rather than meaningful choices.

continue.text: I would try another chapter if it connected systems this clearly, though I'd hope for fewer routine placement steps.
